model: S-75 Dvina (SA-2 Guideline) — V-750VN / 13D missile on СМ-90 single-rail launcher
era: USSR, in service from 1957; 13D airframe = the common Cold-War variant (downed the U-2 in 1960)

missile_overall.src: thisdayinaviation.com/tag/v-750vn-13d-desna (V-750VN/13D, NASM-class data). Variant 1D/SA-2A is shorter (10.6–10.726 m / 2163 kg): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S-75_Dvina + ausairpower.net/APA-S-75-Volkhov.html (Vestnik PVO).

booster.src: dia 0.654 m: thisdayinaviation.com + ausairpower.net (Vestnik PVO), 3 sources agree. length 2.702 m is DERIVED = 10.841 − 8.139 (see derivation; no source gives booster length standalone).

sustainer.src: thisdayinaviation.com/tag/v-750vn-13d-desna ('8.139 meters' for V-750VN). dia 0.500 m confirmed by Wikipedia S-75 Dvina, FAS nuke.fas.org/guide/russia/airdef/v-75.htm, parkpatriot.ru.

nose.shape: ogival nose cone (тело вращения с оживальной носовой частью), houses proximity fuse + radio antenna; small fixed cruciform nose control fins
nose.src: Wikipedia S-75 Dvina; FAS v-75; sovetarmy.forum2x2.ru/t39-topic

fins.desc: 3 cruciform (4×) sets at 45° roll offset: (1) booster tail = large cropped-delta, full span 2.586 m (widest point of the system); (2) sustainer mid/rear wings = cropped-delta, span 1.691 m; (3) small nose control fins (span unsourced).
fins.src: spans: thisdayinaviation.com/tag/v-750vn-13d-desna (13D). shape: Wikipedia S-75 + FAS v-75 ('four large cropped-delta wing fins ... small control surfaces'). Minor conflict: ausairpower gives booster span 2.566 m for the 1D.

launcher_sm90.desc: Single trainable launch beam on a wheeled turntable (SM-63 base). Missile rests on top of the beam on guide skids, held fore+aft; booster exhaust directed aft. Beam ≈ missile length and the missile overhangs the rear.
launcher_sm90.src: sovetarmy.forum2x2.ru/t38-topic (Russian tech data: skid 1600 mm; elev 10–75°; fire-line 2300 mm; travel length ≤10200 mm; track gauge 5435 mm; area 80 m²). ausairpower.net/APA-S-75-Volkhov.html confirms single-rail SM-90.

livery.soviet_pvo: unpainted aluminium / natural metal ('алюминиевый цвет') → modelled as missileGrey
livery.src: sovetarmy.forum2x2.ru (Soviet service aluminium); NASM example is factory green; Vietnamese SA-2s dark green (modelingmadness.com). No official Soviet PVO paint TU located.

derivation.note_nosefin: ESTIMATE, NOT SOURCED — proportionally smaller than the 1.691 m wings; flagged in needs. Used only so the characteristic nose fins exist.
derivation.note_beam: ESTIMATE — 'beam ≈ missile length, missile overhangs rear'; ~ a touch under 10.841. Travel envelope length is 10.2 m. Flagged in needs.
derivation.note_tt: ESTIMATE — base circle dia not in any source (only 80 m² site footprint). Flagged in needs.
